Material Symbols Rounded by Google

Source: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/tree/master/symbols/web
Style: Rounded, optical size 24, default weight and fill.
License: Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE).
Assets are vendored as Android VectorDrawable XML with their original paths.
